🎵 SimonSays

Simon flashes a sequence of colored lights in increasing length, and you must repeat the exact sequence by clicking the colors in order. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Watch the color sequence that Simon plays.
  2. Repeat the sequence exactly in the same order.
  3. The sequence grows longer by one each round — memorize quickly.
  4. Speed of input matters in some modes — click at the right pace.
  5. Your high score is the longest sequence you successfully repeated.
